briefdescription.para: Header-only mock provider factory for AQL Phase 5 unified testing.

detaileddescription.para: Provides MockInferProvider, MockRAGProvider, and MockEmbedProvider with configurable failure modes (success, fail-after-N, timeout, latency injection).

simplesect.para: All providers are header-only and thread-safe for concurrent test use.
No real LLM/embedding infrastructure is required.
